contract_deviations.reason: The orchestrator's brief suggested falling back to NoiseTruth.original_coords when truth_df is absent, but inspecting etl4/bench/noise.py:160-165 confirms original_coords is populated only for jumped_ids (0.1-1% of rows). Using it as an RMSE fallback would reduce RMSE to a jump-only measurement, producing roughly 100 km values for time_gap/kinematic that have a different meaning from the truth_df path and would poison v_pareto_frontier. The correct fix is the one implemented: relax the guard, keep position_rmse_m consuming the truth_df when available, and pass --truth via the CLI.

contract_deviations.deviation: Added --truth etl4/data/reference/synthetic_truth/2026-01-01.parquet to the matrix command. Without it, N0 (which has no sidecar because inject_noise is skipped) produces NULL rmse_m even after the guard relaxation. --truth is already supported by run_matrix.py; this is a CLI call, not a code change.

verification_sql.query: SELECT method, noise, ROUND(rmse_m::numeric,1) AS rmse, ROUND(seg_f1::numeric,3) AS f1, ROUND(seg_precision::numeric,3) AS prec, ROUND(seg_recall::numeric,3) AS rec, ROUND(coverage_ratio::numeric,3) AS cov, ROUND(boundary_err_s::numeric,2) AS b_err FROM fact_experiment_result WHERE source='synthetic' ORDER BY noise, method;

null_count_check.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_experiment_result WHERE source='synthetic' AND (rmse_m IS NULL OR seg_f1 IS NULL OR seg_precision IS NULL OR seg_recall IS NULL OR coverage_ratio IS NULL OR boundary_err_s IS NULL)
